name: Stage 15: Fredriksberg, väg 223 to Skottvångs gruva
description: Official Sörmlandsleden stage 15, Fredriksberg, väg 223 to Skottvångs gruva.
utilities: Official area: Gnesta kommun, Strängnäs kommun.
Fredriksberg/road 223 has limited parking at the former bus-stop/road pocket; the Fredriksberg bus stop has been removed, so use Svinsjö gård as the closest bus context and check live timetables.

Skottvång is the strong service endpoint with parking, restaurant/cafe/pub/event service, seasonal museum, toilet, shower, sauna, tap water, simple lodging, and nearby shelters, but opening, firewood, and booking conditions vary.

Public transport to Skottvång is weak. Bus 543 can be used to Svinsjö gård/Skottvångsvägen context with a road walk, and Sörmlandstrafiken complementary traffic may cover Skottvång on limited pre-booked days; live-check before planning around it.
Road access via Mariefred/Läggesta/väg 223 may be affected by planned autumn 2026 road works around Kärnbogatan/Mariefred access; this is approach logistics rather than a forest-stage closure.
waterSources: The first official spring after about 1.2 km has poor/uncertain supply in summer; carry backup.
The Marvikarna/Långaedet spring before Marviken is an official natural source; treat/filter unless freshly verified.
Skottvång tap water is available through the bystuga/bybastu/service facilities when accessible; treat it as service-linked rather than a guaranteed outdoor public tap.
notes: Sörmlandsleden does not guarantee water quality or availability; treat or filter natural sources and carry backup.
Shelters are generally free, shared, first-come, cannot be booked, and do not guarantee firewood or trash service.
In nature reserves, local camping and fire rules override allemansrätten; fires are often restricted to prepared fireplaces.

Official distance is 10.5 km; Naturkartan agrees, Gnesta municipality rounds to 11 km, and third-party traces are close at about 10.1-10.6 km, with AllTrails-style traces around 10.6 km and roughly 370 m ascent. Naturkartan GPX can export in reversed/segmented pieces with tiny artifacts, so normalize direction as Fredriksberg to Skottvång before ingesting geometry.

OSM relation 3806515 is the correct main Stage 15 geometry, tagged 10.5 km and measuring about 10.29 km by summed member geometry, but its member order is reversed relative to the official Fredriksberg-to-Skottvång direction. The OSM endpoint is within about 2 m of official Fredriksberg and about 12 m of official Skottvång.

Moderate, hilly and sometimes rocky day stage with forest, cultural remains, springs, steep Marvikarna/Långaedet terrain, Stenhuggarmon viewpoint/tower, old ore-railway embankment, and Skottvång mining heritage. In wet, snowy, or icy conditions, expect slower progress than the distance suggests.

The official Stage 15 fault-report field currently says no submitted faults, but an official-page public comment from 2025-08-20 reports many fallen trees near the end toward Skeppsmora-Skottvång and suggests the road for the last about 2 km if needed. Stage 15:2 separately has an official 2025-06-02 fallen-tree warning around Millsjön, where biotope protection limits clearing.
Långaedet reserve has bark-beetle affected spruce that can fall, especially in wind. Reserve rules prohibit damaging living/dead wood except collecting small loose dry twigs for a small fire.

Marvikarna/Krampan rules are stricter: Marvikarna prohibits camping and fires; Krampan allows fires only at designated places and tenting only at marked places for up to two nights. Dogs/pets must be leashed or caged, fishing needs the relevant local permit, and Klövberget/Falkberget bird-protection areas are closed 1 February-15 August.
Mellan-Marviken is a shared hiker/canoe shelter node with two shelters, tent context, toilet, fireplace, bathing, and unknown-quality natural water; it can be busy and firewood is not guaranteed.

Route-builder handling: show 15:1 access only when the selected route reaches the Långaedet junction node 2908209697, and show 15:2 only when the selected route reaches the Mellan-Marviken split node 2908209630 or the southern reconnect node 2298697773. A standalone 15:2 route must include the shared Stage 15 tail from node 2298697773 to Skottvång.
